## Service `CurriculumGraphService`

Read-only access to the published Curriculum Graph snapshot.

| RPC | Request | Response | Description |
|-----|---------|----------|-------------|
| `GetGraphMetadata` | [`GetGraphMetadataRequest`](#getgraphmetadatarequest) | [`GetGraphMetadataResponse`](#getgraphmetadataresponse) | Returns the active graph version and a summary of the served snapshot. |
| `GetNode` | [`GetNodeRequest`](#getnoderequest) | [`GetNodeResponse`](#getnoderesponse) | Returns a single concept by id. Errors: CG_NODE_NOT_FOUND, CG_INVALID_REQUEST, CG_INVALID_GRAPH_VERSION, CG_GRAPH_UNAVAILABLE. |
| `ListNodes` | [`ListNodesRequest`](#listnodesrequest) | [`ListNodesResponse`](#listnodesresponse) | Lists concepts ordered by id, optionally filtered by domain or profile. Errors: CG_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND, CG_INVALID_REQUEST, CG_INVALID_GRAPH_VERSION, CG_GRAPH_UNAVAILABLE. |
| `GetPrerequisites` | [`GetPrerequisitesRequest`](#getprerequisitesrequest) | [`GetPrerequisitesResponse`](#getprerequisitesresponse) | Returns the direct prerequisites of a concept. Errors: CG_NODE_NOT_FOUND, CG_INVALID_REQUEST, CG_INVALID_GRAPH_VERSION, CG_GRAPH_UNAVAILABLE. |
| `GetRegressionTargets` | [`GetRegressionTargetsRequest`](#getregressiontargetsrequest) | [`GetRegressionTargetsResponse`](#getregressiontargetsresponse) | Returns the concepts to revisit when mastery of a concept breaks down. Errors: CG_NODE_NOT_FOUND, CG_INVALID_REQUEST, CG_INVALID_GRAPH_VERSION, CG_GRAPH_UNAVAILABLE. |
| `GetLearningPath` | [`GetLearningPathRequest`](#getlearningpathrequest) | [`GetLearningPathResponse`](#getlearningpathresponse) | Returns the shortest prerequisite path from a start concept to a target concept. An unreachable target is a success with path_found = false. Errors: CG_NODE_NOT_FOUND, CG_INVALID_REQUEST, CG_INVALID_GRAPH_VERSION, CG_GRAPH_UNAVAILABLE. |
| `HealthCheck` | [`HealthCheckRequest`](#healthcheckrequest) | [`HealthCheckResponse`](#healthcheckresponse) | Reports whether the service can answer graph queries. Never fails with a graph error; an unavailable graph is reported as NOT_SERVING. |

## Messages

### RequestContext

Request metadata shared by graph-data RPCs.

| Field | Number | Type | Description |
|-------|--------|------|-------------|
| `request_id` | 1 | `string` | Caller-supplied correlation id. Generated by the server when empty and echoed in ErrorDetail.request_id. |
| `graph_version` | 2 | `string` | Optional graph version the caller expects. Empty means "the active version". A value different from the active version fails with CG_INVALID_GRAPH_VERSION. |

### ErrorDetail

Canonical error payload attached to every failed RPC as a rich status detail: the "grpc-status-details-bin" trailer carries a google.rpc.Status whose details contain exactly one ErrorDetail.

| Field | Number | Type | Description |
|-------|--------|------|-------------|
| `code` | 1 | `string` | Stable canonical code, one of: CG_NODE_NOT_FOUND, CG_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND, CG_INVALID_GRAPH_VERSION, CG_GRAPH_UNAVAILABLE, CG_INVALID_REQUEST. |
| `message` | 2 | `string` | Safe human-readable summary. Never contains infrastructure details. |
| `request_id` | 3 | `string` | Correlation id of the failed request. |
| `graph_version` | 4 | `string` | Active graph version when the request was bound to a known version; empty otherwise. |

### ListNodesRequest

| Field | Number | Type | Description |
|-------|--------|------|-------------|
| `context` | 1 | `RequestContext` |  |
| `domain` | 2 | `string` | Only nodes of this domain. Empty means no domain filter. |
| `profile_id` | 3 | `string` | Only nodes referenced by this curriculum profile. Empty means no filter. |
| `page_size` | 4 | `int32` | Maximum number of nodes to return. 0 means the server default (100); values above 1000 are capped at 1000. Negative values are invalid. |
| `page_token` | 5 | `string` | Opaque token from a previous ListNodesResponse.next_page_token. |

Kind of prerequisite relationship.

| Value | Number | Description |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `PREREQUISITE_KIND_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 |  |
| `PREREQUISITE_KIND_HARD` | 1 | Required before attempting the dependent concept. |
